text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...!
*wheeze*! *pant*! *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Haah, CB's debut race must be
starting right about now. I can't help but wonder...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, but... there's no time for that! If I wanna
become a norm-breaking 'Ace', I still have a long way to go...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Hell yeah! Let's do this! One more rep!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of Mr. C.B.'s debut race had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: I heard that Mr. C.B. girl is incredible! Apparently, her late-race kick has insane power.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see.
You've really done your research, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I just started watching races recently and got hooked!
I've been keeping tabs on the girls they say have potential!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Word on the street is that CB might even have what it takes to become a Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown, huh. I watched back when the girl hailed as a 'Myth' claimed the Triple Crown too...
She really was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Whoa, are you serious?! I've watched the footage a bunch of times, but you're seriously incredible!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing it live was even more amazing than on video.
When she won the Kikuka Sho, the place went wild.
Everyone was so hyped up..."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, is that so!
Man, that's awesome, I wish I could've seen it live too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: CB-chan, congrats on entering the race~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations from me as well. I'll be quietly
praying for your meteoric rise to greatness."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thank you, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Student Council President Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky,
known as the Supercar, had come together to offer their encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...So, Rudolf, are you asking as a friend? Or as the student council president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course, as a friend... is what I'd like to say, but... probably both.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It may be a premature wish, but watching you run,
I am certain many girls will come to look up to you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I won't tell you to lead the way.
I just want you to stay as you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still... please forgive me for secretly finding joy
in the seeds of hope that you create."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're overestimating me.
Besides, isn't that kind of thing your job?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sow your own seeds.
...I'll be waiting for your debut next year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You're right.
Thank you, C.B."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf firmly grasped the outstretched right hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to train hard so we can have a fierce battle worthy of dragon versus tiger. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Well, about that time. It's time to get going.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wish you the best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Have a great run, CB-chan!
Come on, you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you.
Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to it. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A debut race awaited more eagerly than anyone's.
The legend of Mr. C.B. is finally about to begin.
